headline: Players can pack edited Ratchet & Clank objects and play them through Mods
summary: The level editor can pack moved, rotated, scaled or otherwise edited game objects back into Ratchet & Clank's data, and the launcher gains a Mods page for editing, packing and playing those changes. Unchanged objects retain their original bytes, while added and deleted objects are reported and left out. Per-level Godot projects let players open one planet instead of importing every level. Master receives direct development rather than its usual release-only activity.
highlights: The launcher presents one main action per game and keeps developer details behind Developer tools.
Website progress is cached outside tracked source files and only overrides the checkout's figures when newer.
Going Commando is imported afresh after its upstream rebuild, so much of the large source churn replaces the old generated-source layout.
Windows gets a native-program build check after platform-specific failures, and conflicting declarations are repaired so previously dropped source units generate again.
The author had not visually checked the new level picker.
